prompt_verbatim:
Create a NEW production animation sprite sheet based closely on the supplied reference art. This is an extension of an existing game character, not a redesign. EXACT layout: FOUR equal-width columns and TWO equal-height rows, EIGHT isolated complete character poses, ordered left to right, no ninth pose. Transparent RGBA background with no opaque backdrop, no shadows outside the body, no grid lines, labels, text, effects, sparks, particles, blood or motion trails. The sheet is a landscape 2:1 canvas with square cells, equal generous transparent padding per cell. Keep matching scale, camera, anatomy, materials, lighting and contour treatment between every frame. Face RIGHT in all frames including prone poses. Same upper-left soft light and bright broad material planes, dark joints; no neon or glossy plastic. These are actual anatomical redraws: joint angles, head relative to torso, limb contact positions, folded limbs and silhouette visibly change. Do NOT create copies differing only in global rotation, translation, stretch, tint or alpha. Every complete body fits inside its own cell without touching borders or neighbouring bodies. Row one is four hurt/recovery keyframes, row two is four death keyframes. Last death frame is a clearly dead but intact body suitable to remain visible on the floor indefinitely; no explosion, dissolution, skeleton or disappearance. Last frame keeps readable midtones with extinguished eye.

REFERENCE: use ONLY the moss-covered side-facing right beetle character shown in the supplied image, not the background. Preserve its broad low acorn-like domed green moss shell, distinctive pale limestone branching bands, paired short curved horn/tusks, round amber eye, brown segmented insect legs, warm hand-drawn outlined textured material style. Preserve original species and shell patterns; do not convert it into a boar or Underworld sprite. Keep a simplified broad illuminated moss midtone and cream limestone stripe, matching original warm illustration style. TOP ROW: H1 front of head jerks backward, near foreleg bent and lifted while hind feet brace; H2 neck tucked into shell, front knees sharply bent and abdomen lowered, individual legs recoiling; H3 head and front legs begin extending while one rear leg still tucked, shell recovers support; H4 near original ready pose with four distinct supporting legs and calm amber eye. BOTTOM ROW: D1 front knees buckle and head dips sharply while rear legs lose extension; D2 body tips onto its visible flank with belly plate revealed, front and rear legs curl toward belly rather than remaining upright; D3 shell-side contacts the ground, head slumps sideways, several legs loosely folded without supporting the body; D4 visibly dead stable side-lying beetle, domed moss shell low to the ground, pale stripe and horn recognizable, legs folded and no standing support, amber eye dark and unlit. Keep same body volume through poses, no detached parts.
